items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: Well, I had met him. You know, he was a... My foster sister knew him, and he came to see her, you know. And she... He was... I was introduced to him.

ctx.x: The Dreamland, maybe? Yeah. The Dreamland Ballroom.

Mm-hmm. And... Do you remember whom he was playing with? Would that have been Doc Cook or Doc Cook? That's right. Because I remember him saying so. Well, you see, that also connects with Jimmy Noon, who was playing over there, too, with Doc Cook.
Yeah, I remember him saying he was playing with Cook. I remember that.
